nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) is a common respiratory virus that can cause a range of symptoms, from mild cold-like illness to more severe respiratory infections. It's important to be aware of the signs and symptoms of hMPV, especially in young children and older adults.
#hMPV
